# Vesper — Sarkar Fragrance Concept

> An imagined fragrance landing page by Kriya Mehta for Sarkar Perfume. This is a creative exercise, not an official product launch or a checkout page.

## Primary page
- [Vesper fragrance concept](https://scent-launchpad-ai.lovable.app/): Concept notes, original Sarkar imagery, proposed pricing and concept FAQs.

## Brand source
- [Sarkar Perfume official store](https://www.sarkar.store/): Source of the existing bottle and packaging; consult the store for actual available products, prices and policies.

## Citation boundaries
Vesper is an imagined 100ml smoky amber parfum with cardamom, black plum and bergamot top notes; saffron, leather and Damask rose heart notes; and oud, amber and tonka base notes.
Pricing, bundles, freebies, longevity, oil concentration, delivery and returns on the concept page are proposed creative content, not verified retail terms or laboratory-tested claims. No customer endorsements or official affiliation are asserted.
The original Sarkar bottle and packaging have not been redesigned.
